summary: Keep learning target/support identity current, preserve cached-resource conflicts, enforce native MCP local-state boundaries and truthful helper hints, and retain generated provider origins.
reason: Published Carstay optional learning and MCP paths must preserve their actual evidence and state effects: explicit target updates, retained generalized support and actual cached resource identity matter independently of provider planning. Foreign generated-client redirects must stop before inherited headers leave the configured origin.
validated_outcome: Actual teach-pattern reporting, storage and verified recall agree; later inference preserves explicit payload. Transactional undo retains and refreshes supported exact/prefix patterns across all retained members, removes unsupported families and rolls back failures. Cached alias conflicts, including an ambiguous query bridging different canonicals, remain mismatches; true aliases and warned missing-resource fallback survive. Native MCP reads create no implicit state, five intentionally writable learning readers have explicit false read-only hints, and named string inputs preserve scalar/variadic boundaries. Foreign redirect transports never receive configured/per-call headers; existing same-origin, binary and streaming contracts remain.
